_doc: Texture sets generated by `hdart textures <set>` with FLUX.2-klein in ComfyUI. Each entry becomes textures/<set>/<id>.png (made tileable) plus <id>_n.png (normal map). Character materials only feed shading detail and bump (colour comes from palette ramps), so they are prompted as neutral grey. Biome textures keep their colour; tile renders reduce them to the biome palette.

materials.suffix: , seamless tileable texture, flat even lighting, orthographic top-down, neutral grey, no shadows, high detail

cloth1.prompt: coarse woven wool fabric texture, visible weave

cloth2.prompt: linen canvas fabric texture with subtle folds

leather.prompt: worn leather texture with scratches and stitching

metal.prompt: hammered iron plate texture, dents and scratches

hair.prompt: dense flowing hair strands texture, directional

skin.prompt: smooth matte clay surface texture, very subtle

crypt.suffix: , seamless tileable texture, orthographic top-down view, flat diffuse lighting, dark fantasy dungeon, muted desaturated colours

floor.prompt: old cracked flagstone floor, irregular grey stone slabs with dark mortar and dust

wall.prompt: ancient crypt wall of rough grey stone bricks, mossy cracks

pillar.prompt: carved weathered limestone surface with vertical fluting

door.prompt: old dark oak planks bound with rusty iron straps and rivets

rubble.prompt: pile of broken stone rubble and gravel, scattered rocks

bone.prompt: scattered old bones and skulls on dusty stone
